prose: Where we are: 558 contracts pulled all-time (255 archived on archive.org, 344 small-file sets on GitHub — earlier sessions' work included); 303 staged and waiting on the drain. In the last 24h: 344 pulled, 41 archived. we're pulling faster than archive.org can take it right now (303 staged).
123 department(s) still sit behind the portal's 1,000-row search wall (the enumeration gaps) — completeness stays contested there until the deep lane subdivides past the cap.
Completeness verdicts across departments: 3 complete, 3 incomplete, 0 contested, 114 unexamined (unexamined means not crawled yet — never counted as a pass).
Last QC pass: flagging problems (37 clean, 0 suspicious, 12 defect).
Processing ladder: 0 of 558 pulled are fully processed — PDF archived on archive.org, text extracted, read by eoreader7, small files on GitHub (255 archived, 0 read).

Missing: recount found 7679 contract(s) the portal still shows that we don't hold yet — FINANCE −2464; WATER SERVICES −2432; FILM OFFICE −1332; GENERAL SERVICES −1062; FIRE −354; AFFORDABLE HOUSING −35. Every count is a concrete lower bound; caps are declared, never hidden.
Self-healing: 1 oversight action(s) on record (restart/ream/timer arms, fetch pauses on disk pressure) — each with a falsifying control.
Note: every total here is the live picture at this moment — they grow as the crawl discovers and archives more contracts.
